entries.label: Très légère
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: separate HEADGEAR OVERLAY for a native 64x64 cyberpunk roguelike player sprite.
Reference image role: material and rendering guide ONLY, a teal technical coat with copper prostheses and charcoal joints. Do not draw the body from the reference.
Draw ONE head protection piece in a STRAIGHT FRONT worn position. Only physical headgear, NO person, human face, mannequin, skull, hair, head anatomy, neck, shoulders, torso or stand.
This gear overlays an existing partly human partly robotic head. Any open face area MUST be truly ALPHA-ZERO EMPTY so the old head shows through. Do not fill an open face area with a dark lining, rear shell, black mannequin, flesh or tinted glass. Opaque masks are permitted ONLY where explicitly requested.
Class identity: an extensively augmented machine technician with a technical coat, workwear and cybernetic apparatus. Strong narrow hood/cowl silhouette, industrial function, no fantasy jewelry, no religious insignia or licensed symbols.
Palette: muted deep TEAL fabric/casing, charcoal inner edging, a FEW broad aged COPPER guards, at most one amber accent. NO ivory/white soldier helmet, bulky round marine helmet or silver suit.
Native gear will be only 10-14 pixels across and 5-13 pixels tall. Use extremely few big simple masses, 2-3 broad tones per material, continuous dark outer contour, subtle upper-left light. No seams/rivets/screws/textures/tiny vents, wires, external tubes, antennas, spikes or dangling ornaments.
Isolated centered object, ample transparent margin, genuine transparent background and transparent face opening. No labels, text, ground shadow, vignette, glow or light halo.

VERY LIGHT: a low charcoal padded forehead workband with a broad simple copper reinforcement at its sides and a restrained teal top insert. A shallow UPPER-CROWN guard, about twice as wide as tall. NO ear cups, cheek guards, jaw, mask, visor, hood or back shell. The whole face below the brow and the entire lower half of the image remain empty transparent. Low unobtrusive protection for the short work jacket.
